_notes: Registrant successors (ADR-063). A snapshot CIK that has not filed its own 10-K yet is read through its predecessor registrant: the fetcher uses the predecessor's companyfacts and latest 10-K until the successor's submissions list a 10-K of its own. Every value keeps its true accession and URL (the predecessor's). An entry needs a succession filing as evidence (Form 8-K12B or similar); a spin-off or a new listing (Form 10-12B) is NOT a succession and gets no entry: such a company has no annual report yet.
